rule: No optimization objective overrides a hard constraint. Scalable breaches are scaled down proportionally (binding recorded); non-scalable violations (authorization, drawdown, turnover) reject with weights cleared. Constraints are NEVER silently relaxed.
capital_constraints: Buying power / available cash / pending reservations are enforced downstream by the native RiskEngine + CapitalReservationLedger (see capital_reservation_validation.json).
verdict: All §8 hard constraints enforced; infeasible -> safe scale-down or explicit rejection.
